text:
How to use these pages

Work through the parts of each session in order.
Run each code cell as you reach it; edit and re-run to experiment.
Where a page has an exercise, attempt it before using the hints, and check the solution only after making your own attempt.

Your work here is not saved when you close the tab. These pages are for working through the sessions; anything you need to submit goes through Canvas as described in the relevant brief.
